title: Network Specialist
description:
Job Title
  
  
Network Specialist
  
  
**Job Description**
*Effective April 1, 2026, Toyota Automated Logistics brings together Bastian Solutions, Vanderlande’s Warehousing Business, and Viastore under one unified brand.*
*During this transition phase, parts of our recruitment activities and communication may still be conducted via legacy company systems and email domains.*
**Senior Network Engineer | Pune, India| Full-time**
**Your Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Network Engineer to join our global IT Operations Center (ITOC). The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise network infrastructure across global data centers and business locations. This role requires strong expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, VPN technologies, wireless networking, network security, and operational support within a 24x7 environment.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring network availability, performance, security, and continuous improvement through automation and proactive infrastructure management.
  
  
**What You Will Do/Key Responsibilities**
**Network Operations & Support**

* Monitor and maintain the health, performance, and availability of global network infrastructure and data center environments.
* Provide advanced L2 and L3 support for network incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
* Troubleshoot complex network connectivity, performance, and security issues across LAN, WAN, WLAN, and VPN environments.
* Take ownership of critical incidents and ensure timely resolution within defined SLAs.
* Collaborate with global IT teams, business units, and external vendors for issue resolution and service improvements.

**Network Administration & Engineering**

* Configure, deploy, and support

+ Layer 2 & Layer 3 Switches
+ Enterprise Routers
+ Cisco ASA / Firepower Firewalls
+ Wireless LAN Controllers and Access Points
+ VPN Gateways and Remote Access Solutions
+ Load Balancers and QoS Implementations

* Design, implement, and support secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN solutions.
* Perform network infrastructure upgrades, firmware updates, security patching, and lifecycle management activities.
* Execute approved changes following established change management and configuration management processes

**Network Monitoring & Performance Management**

* Utilize enterprise monitoring and diagnostic tools such as

+ Nagios
+ Wireshark
+ PRTG
+ SNMP-based monitoring solutions

* Proactively identify performance bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Analyze network traffic patterns and capacity requirements to improve infrastructure efficiency and reliability.
* Develop and maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, asset inventories, and operational procedures

**Network Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain network security controls, firewall rules, VPN configurations, and access policies.
* Monitor network security events and collaborate with cybersecurity teams to mitigate risks.
* Ensure compliance with corporate security standards, best practices, and regulatory requirements.
* Participate in vulnerability remediation and security improvement initiatives.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Develop scripts and automated workflows for network monitoring, reporting, configuration backup, and routine maintenance tasks.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization and service enhancements.
* Contribute to network architecture reviews and infrastructure modernization projects.

**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  
**Certifications**

* CCNA and CCNP Certification (Mandatory)
* Additional certifications such as Cisco Security, Fortinet, Palo Alto, or ITIL are highly preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, STP, OSPF, BGP, NAT, ACLs, QoS, and VPN technologies.
* Deep understanding of OSI and TCP/IP networking models.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco routing and switching technologies.
* Expertise in Cisco ASA/Firepower firewall administration and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting WAN, SD-WAN, MPLS, VPN, and wireless network environments.
* Proficiency with network monitoring, packet analysis, and troubleshooting tools.
* Knowledge of network security frameworks and best practices.
* Experience in automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies is preferred.

**Required Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural team environment.
* Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Excellent time management, prioritization, and incident management skills.
* Ability to perform under pressure in a 24x7 operational environment.
* Strong documentation and support case management skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting enterprise-scale global networks and data centers.
* Experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC) or IT Operations Center environment.
* Familiarity with cloud networking concepts (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud).
* Exposure to network automation and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.
* Experience with ITIL service management processes.

**About TAL**
At Toyota Automated Logistics, you actively shape the future of intelligent intralogistics. As part of Toyota Industries Corporation (TICO), we are a global partner for integrated warehouse automation solutions. Founded in April 2026, we bring together the strengths of Bastian Solutions, viastore, and Vanderlande’s warehousing business under one unified brand.
  
  
Together, we develop scalable automation systems, intelligent software, and end‑to‑end services across the entire lifecycle for customers around the world. Our ambition is clear to set industry benchmarks and actively shape the future of intralogistics.
  
  
**Website**
www.toyota-automated-logistics.com
  
  
**What We Offer**
Working at TAL comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including

+ 22 paid leave days
+ 8 sick/casual leave days
+ Applicable government holidays

* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage
* Opportunities to participate in diverse communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance.

**Ready to join Toyota Automated Logistics? We look forward to hearing from you!**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Toyota Automated Logistics, we believe diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to equal opportunities and an inclusive work environment, and base our hiring decisions on qualifications, potential, and motivation. Support or adjustments during the application process are available upon request.

title: MCU Networking & Diagnostics Engineer (TT610ST RM 4527)
description:
**Position: MCU Networking & Diagnostics Engineer (TT610ST RM 4527)**
**Automotive MCU / Networking & Diagnostics**
**Role Purpose**
Design, develop, integrate, and validate MCU-based automotive communication and diagnostic software, ensuring robust vehicle-network connectivity, standards-compliant diagnostics, reliable fault handling, and traceable delivery across ECU programs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and configure MCU communication stacks for CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, and transport protocols based on project architecture.
* Develop and integrate diagnostic services using UDS, DoIP, OBD, DTC management, diagnostic sessions, security access, and routine control.
* Configure AUTOSAR communication and diagnostic modules, including COM, PduR, CanIf, CanTp, Dcm, Dem, NvM interfaces, and Ethernet-related services where applicable.
* Translate customer signal databases, diagnostic specifications, and network descriptions into maintainable software configurations and interface contracts.
* Implement network management, wake-up and sleep handling, communication control, timeout supervision, bus-off recovery, and degraded-mode behavior.
* Perform bench, SIL, HIL, and vehicle-level debugging using traces, bus logs, diagnostic logs, and MCU runtime measurements.
* Ensure bidirectional traceability from networking and diagnostic requirements through design, implementation, configuration, and verification evidence.
* Coordinate with system, BSW, application, validation, cybersecurity, and customer teams to resolve interface issues and deliver production-ready releases

**Required Experience And Competencies**

* Strong embedded C development and debugging experience on automotive microcontrollers.
* Hands-on knowledge of CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, DoIP, UDS, ISO-TP, OBD, and vehicle network management concepts.
* Experience with AUTOSAR Classic communication and diagnostic BSW configuration, integration, and issue analysis.
* Ability to interpret DBC, ARXML, ODX, CDD, diagnostic extracts, signal matrices, and customer interface specifications.
* Proficiency with bus analyzers, debuggers, diagnostic testers, oscilloscopes, and log-analysis methods.
* Good understanding of ASPICE engineering practices, functional safety awareness, cybersecurity constraints, and disciplined defect resolution

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Vector CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, DaVinci Configurator/Developer, EB tresos, or equivalent automotive tools.
* Exposure to bootloaders, secure diagnostics, OTA or flash programming, Ethernet test tools, scripting, and test automation.

**Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant industry experience may also be considered.
  
  
**Expected Leadership Behaviors**

* Own networking and diagnostic delivery outcomes with clear interface governance, risk communication, and timely escalation.
* Promote reusable configurations, coding discipline, peer reviews, automation, and evidence-based engineering decisions.
* Coach engineers in protocol analysis, systematic debugging, customer communication, and cross-domain issue resolution

title: Sr Principal Network & Security
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Senior Principal Network Security Engineer is the highest-level individual contributor responsible for leading the design, engineering, and delivery of complex, multi-team network security initiatives. This role owns end-to-end technical execution for enterprise perimeter, internal segmentation, and application delivery controls, with deep hands-on expertise in Check Point firewalls and F5 load balancers. The engineer serves as a technical authority, driving architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and ensuring operational resiliency through automation, rigorous troubleshooting, and incident mitigation.
  
  
Primary Technology Focus
  
  

* Designing, Securing and building scalable, resilient enterprise-wide network
* Define and monitor - network security standards / Controls across on prem, hybrid and Private cloud networks through new generation firewalls / IDS/IPS, Micro segmentation and VPN’s
* Monitor and mitigate the network and security incidents across global events on prem, hybrid and private networks
* Ensure Audit and regulatory compliance requirements are implemented across network segmentations, firewalls, VPN’s and at perimeter security devices
* Check Point Firewalls (policy design, NAT, VPN, threat prevention, logging/telemetry, upgrades and migrations)
* F5 Load Balancers (LTM/ASM/APM as applicable; iRules; TLS profiles; health monitoring; high availability)
* Network routing and switching (BGP/OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, QoS, high-availability designs)
* Wireless networking (enterprise Wi‑Fi architectures, security controls, segmentation, troubleshooting)
* Secure web proxy platforms (forward proxy, TLS inspection, policy enforcement, troubleshooting)
* Enterprise network security initiatives (segmentation, zero trust patterns, control hardening, resiliency improvements)

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the engineering delivery of complex network security and application delivery projects involving multiple teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Architect, implement, and operate Check Point firewall solutions including policy lifecycle management, NAT strategy, VPN solutions, and threat prevention capabilities.
* Design and engineer F5 load balancing solutions with strong understanding of traffic management, TLS, application health, and high availability.
* Develop and maintain automation for network security operations (e.g., configuration management, policy deployment, compliance validation, telemetry and reporting).
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical incidents—debug, mitigate, and resolve high-severity outages and security events across network/security domains.
* Establish engineering standards and reference architectures for firewalling, load balancing, routing/switching, wireless, and proxy capabilities.
* Drive continuous improvement: reduce toil, improve MTTR, implement reliability patterns, and proactively address technical debt.
* Partner with security engineering, infrastructure, application, and cloud teams to deliver secure-by-design solutions and ensure change safety.
* Conduct deep root-cause analysis (RCA) and produce actionable post-incident improvements, runbooks, and automation enhancements.
* Mentor senior engineers and provide technical leadership through design reviews, architecture boards, and operational readiness assessments.
* Monitor and manage information system security incidents, troubleshoot, investigate and implement countermeasures and mitigate the risk.
* Plan the Network recovery / DR / resilience from malware / attacks, unauthorized access, and policy breaches;
* Engage, interact and coordinate with third-party Network / Telecom/ service providers during security incidents.
* Analyze Network security trends and changes in threat and compliance environment and develop and executes plans for compliance and mitigation of risk

**Required Qualifications**

* Extensive, hands-on engineering experience with enterprise network security, including deep expertise in Check Point firewalls and F5 load balancers.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional technical initiatives from design through implementation and operational handoff.
* Advanced knowledge of routing and switching, including dynamic routing (BGP/OSPF), redundancy, and troubleshooting at scale.
* Strong understanding of wireless networking and secure web proxy concepts, including policy enforcement and traffic inspection.
* Proven automation skills (required): scripting and/or infrastructure-as-code to integrate with CI/CD pipelines and ITSM workflows.
* Significant experience troubleshooting and resolving critical incidents, including packet-level analysis and performance triage.
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation: design artifacts, standards, runbooks, and post-incident reports.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to influence architecture decisions and drive alignment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant industry certifications with major network/security vendors (e.g., Check Point CCSA/CCSE/CCSM, F5-CA/F5-CSE, Cisco CCNP, Palo Alto PCNSE, Fortinet NSE, etc.).
* Advanced certifications such as CCIE Security, CCDE, CISSP, or equivalent is highly desired.
* Experience with modern security patterns (e.g., zero trust segmentation, SASE concepts, secure access) and enterprise logging/telemetry platforms.
* Experience integrating network/security automation with ServiceNow and/or other ITSM systems.
* Experience with cloud networking and security controls (e.g., Azure/AWS/GCP) and hybrid connectivity patterns.
* Hands-on experience with tooling such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Git, CI/CD, API-driven device management, and configuration compliance frameworks.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Technical authority and systems thinking across security, network, and application delivery layers

title: Active Directory Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Cyberaube is a cybersecurity services company based in Nagpur and Pune that focuses on practical, vendor-neutral solutions instead of product reselling. The team brings over a decade of hands-on experience with leading security platforms such as QRadar, Splunk, CyberArk, Okta, and Guardium, helping clients avoid costly implementation mistakes. Cyberaube supports organizations with security talent placement, SIEM and IAM operations, data protection, and compliance with India’s DPDP Act and SEBI requirements. The company works with a diverse range of clients, including banks, hospitals, e-commerce firms, government bodies, and SaaS startups across India and beyond.

**Role Description**

* Senior Active Directory Engineer (L3) – Multi-Forest Enterprise
* Location: Pune or Nagpur (WFO)
* Experience: 7+ years
* Notice: Immediate–30 days preferred

**About the role**

We are looking for an L3 Active Directory engineer who owns the directory, not just the tickets in it. You will be the final technical escalation point for a large, multi-forest, multi-domain, multi-site Active Directory estate. When replication breaks, SYSVOL drifts or a DC fails, you read the repadmin and dcdiag output, find the root cause and fix it yourself.

**What will you do**

- Design, build and extend multi-domain and multi-forest AD: new domains, forest and external trusts, selective authentication, SID filtering and cross-forest DNS.

- Own replication health across a multi-site topology: sites, subnets, site links, costs, bridgeheads and KCC/ISTG behaviour.

- Diagnose and resolve deep replication failures: lingering objects, USN rollback, tombstone lifetime issues, and errors such as 8606, 8614, 8524 and 1722, using repadmin, dcdiag, ntdsutil and PowerShell.

- Support SYSVOL on DFSR: backlog analysis, dirty shutdown recovery, authoritative and non-authoritative restores, and FRS-to-DFSR migration where legacy domains remain.

- Manage the full DC lifecycle: promotion, demotion, forced removal, metadata cleanup, FSMO transfer and seizure, Global Catalog placement and OS upgrades.

- Run proactive DC health monitoring: define checks and alert thresholds, review Directory Service, DFS Replication and DNS logs, and act before users notice.

- Lead AD incident response for P1/P2 events and write the RCA and problem records that remove the cause, not just the symptom.

- Maintain AD backup and disaster recovery: system state backups, DSRM, and forest recovery planning and testing.

- Mentor L1/L2 engineers, write runbooks, and raise and execute change requests to ITIL standards.

**What you must have:**

- 7+ years in Windows infrastructure, including 5+ years of hands-on L3 Active Directory engineering in a large enterprise.

- Production experience in multi-forest and multi-domain environments, including setting up and troubleshooting trusts.

- Command-line fluency with repadmin, dcdiag, ntdsutil, dfsrdiag, nltest, setspn and the PowerShell ActiveDirectory module.

- A track record of resolving replication and SYSVOL/DFSR failures yourself, not escalating them.

- Experience leading AD incidents end to end, including writing the root cause analysis.

- An active Microsoft certification: Windows Server Administrator Associate (AZ-802), Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800 + AZ-801), or legacy MCSA/MCSE: Windows Server.

**Good to have:**

- AD CS / PKI, ADFS, Entra Connect in a multi-forest topology

- AD security hardening: tiered administration, LAPS, Kerberos/NTLM hardening, privileged group control

- Domain migrations or consolidations with ADMT or Quest

- PowerShell automation for health reporting and remediation

**THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF...**

Your Active Directory experience is mainly user and group administration, password resets and lockouts, SSO/Okta onboarding, or Entra ID and Conditional Access. Those are valuable skills, but this role is about the infrastructure underneath: domain controllers, replication, SYSVOL, trusts and forest design.

Please apply OR you may also send your resume with other details such as your current CTC, your expected CTC and your tetative availability to join if offered at info[at]cyberaube[dot]com

**Job Description**
The Zscaler Technical Engineer will be responsible for the administration, and support of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platforms. The role focuses on securing internet and private application access for users through Zero Trust architecture, ensuring high availability, security compliance, and optimal performance.
  
  
**Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)**

* Manage ZIA security policies including URL filtering, SSL inspection, sandboxing, firewall policies, and data loss prevention (DLP).
* Manage and troubleshoot Zscaler Client Connector for endpoint traffic forwarding.
* Integrate ZIA with identity providers (Azure AD, Okta, etc.) for user authentication and policy enforcement.
* Implement and manage PAC files, GRE/IPsec tunnels, and proxy configurations.
* Monitor internet traffic using ZIA dashboards, logs, and analytics.
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues related to DNS, proxy, SSL inspection, and application access.

**Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)**

* Manage and administrate Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) using ZPA.
* Manage App Connectors, Service Edges, and Application Segments.
* Define access policies based on user identity, device posture, and application context.
* Integrate ZPA with Identity Providers (SSO) and endpoint posture solutions.
* Manage private application onboarding and segmentation.
* Troubleshoot application access issues and optimize connectivity.
* Maintain high availability and scalability of ZPA infrastructure.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience with Zscaler ZIA and ZPA platforms.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
* Experience with DNS, TCP/IP, VPN, Proxy, SSL/TLS, and network security concepts.
* Experience with identity integrations (Azure AD, SAML, OAuth).
* Good understanding on Z-Identity.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

**Good to have Certifications**

* Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP)
* Zscaler Certified Specialist (ZCS)
* Zscaler Certified Expert (ZCE)

**Qualifications**
5+ years of experience in network / cloud security Including Zscaler Technologies

Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.
* Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.

* Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.

title: Senior Hyper-V Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Dataction**

Our engagement models provide the perfect blend of quality, control, and cost for our customers.
  
  
To know more about Dataction, please visit https://dataction.co
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Hyper-V Infrastructure Engineer to build the target Microsoft Hyper-V platform and migrate our client's server workloads off VMware safely and on schedule. The client's VMware licences expire in November 2026, so this is a time-critical, hands-on delivery role. The successful candidate will act as the senior technical authority for the server workload migration on HPE ProLiant hosts: ~100 production server VMs (TAG cluster) and a single-host backup recovery cluster moving from VMware vSphere 8.0 to Microsoft Hyper-V. He/She will plan and run a rolling host-by-host migration, protect service continuity throughout, work closely with the VDI/XenServer workstream, and leave behind documentation the client's operations team can run with.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft Hyper-V Platform Build & Hardening

+ Build, configure, and harden Hyper-V hosts (Windows Server 2019/2022 Datacenter) on HPE ProLiant hardware, including iLO, firmware/SPP, and driver compliance.
+ Design and deploy Hyper-V Failover Clusters: Cluster Shared Volumes, quorum/witness, live migration, and Switch Embedded Teaming.
+ Configure virtual networking (Hyper-V virtual switches, VLANs, SET/NIC teaming) and SAN storage connectivity (iSCSI/FC, MPIO) to match the existing VMware design.
+ Deploy and configure management tooling (SCVMM and/or Windows Admin Center), including host groups, logical networks, VM templates, and role-based access.
+ Stand up the Hyper-V environment for ~100 production server VMs (TAG cluster) and the single-host recovery environment.
+ Integrate the new hosts with Active Directory, DNS, monitoring, and patching tooling.

* Server Workload Migration (VMware Exit)

+ Assess the VMware vSphere 8.0 server estate (clusters, VM inventory, application dependencies, networks, datastores) and produce the migration plan and cutover schedule against the 11 November 2026 deadline.
+ Run a rolling migration: evacuate a host, rebuild it as Hyper-V, migrate workloads, and repeat, using spare cluster capacity to avoid disruption.
+ Convert and migrate VMs using appropriate V2V tooling (e.g. SCVMM, Windows Admin Center VM Conversion, Veeam restore to Hyper-V), including VMware Tools removal, Integration Services, Generation 1/2 decisions, and network/IP re-mapping.
+ Plan and execute a safe approach for the single-host recovery cluster, where no spare capacity exists.
+ Define test, validation, and rollback procedures for each cutover, and coordinate change windows, out-of-hours activity, and application owner sign-off with the client.
+ Decommission VMware hosts once workloads are verified and signed off.

* Backup, Resilience & Security

+ Rebuild and migrate the Veeam backup server and backup proxy onto Hyper-V; reconfigure backup jobs for Hyper-V and confirm repositories and restore tests work on the new platform.
+ Configure high availability, VM placement and anti-affinity rules, and checkpoint policies for production workloads.
+ Apply security hardening aligned to CIS Benchmarks and Microsoft Security Baselines on all new hosts.
+ Establish patching and lifecycle processes for the new hosts (e.g. WSUS / SCCM / MECM / Cluster-Aware Updating).

* Automation, Documentation & Handover

+ Automate repetitive build, configuration, and migration tasks using PowerShell (Hyper-V and FailoverClusters modules).
+ Produce build documentation, runbooks, and operational handover for the client's infrastructure team, and brief them on day-to-day management.
+ Coordinate with the Citrix XenServer / VDI workstream on shared hardware, networks, storage, and the overall migration schedule.

**Qualification, Skills And Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in virtualisation and Wintel infrastructure, with deep hands-on expertise in Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience building and managing Microsoft Hyper-V hosts and Failover Clusters (Cluster Shared Volumes, live migration, quorum, Switch Embedded Teaming) in production.
* Strong experience with System Center Virtual Machine Manager and/or Windows Admin Center for managing Hyper-V at scale.

title: Senior Citrix XenServer & VDI Engineer
description:
**About Dataction**
Dataction is a new age services firm that offers best in class information technology, analytics, and consulting services to renowned international companies. Dataction was established in 2010 and has grown rapidly over the last decade. Dataction has built a reputation for providing differentiated and reliable services to a wide range of customers across multiple sectors.
  
  
At Dataction we connect every dot and reimagine every business process. Our lean, agile, and analytical approach towards problem solving and execution, helps our client achieve sustainable growth and secure a profitable business, while safeguarding a viable future. Our people are committed, courageous, and unafraid of pushing boundaries. They help our clients make decisions that deliver immediate and measurable benefits, justifying investments. Our engagement models provide the perfect blend of quality, control, and cost for our customers.
  
  
To know more about Dataction, please visit https://dataction.co
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Citrix XenServer & VDI Engineer to build the target Citrix XenServer platform and migrate our client's VDI estate off VMware safely and on schedule. The client's VMware licences expire in November 2026, so this is a time-critical, hands-on delivery role. The successful candidate will act as the senior technical authority for the VDI migration across 10 HPE ProLiant hosts: ~400 VDI desktops moving from VMware vSphere 8.0 to Citrix XenServer. He/She will plan and run a rolling host-by-host migration, protect the end-user experience throughout, work closely with the client's Citrix team and the Hyper-V workstream, and leave behind documentation the client's operations team can run with.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Citrix XenServer Platform Build & Management

+ Build and configure Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor hosts and resource pools on HPE ProLiant hardware (10 hosts), including iLO, firmware/SPP, and hardware compatibility compliance.
+ Configure storage repositories (iSCSI/FC/NFS with multipathing), NIC bonding, networks/VLANs, and pool HA to match the existing VMware design.
+ Manage the estate via XenCenter and the xe CLI, including pool master design, Active Directory integration, role-based access, and host update/hotfix lifecycle.
+ Size and tune pool capacity (CPU, memory, storage IOPS, read caching) for ~400 concurrent desktops.
+ Integrate the new hosts with Active Directory, DNS, monitoring, and patching tooling.

* Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops Integration

+ Work with the client's Citrix team to create hosting connections and resources from the Delivery Controllers to the new XenServer pools.
+ Prepare and optimise golden images for XenServer (XenServer VM Tools, Citrix VDA, Citrix Optimizer) and rebuild machine catalogs using MCS/PVS.
+ Validate machine catalog and delivery group configuration, power management, and provisioning behaviour after each stage.
+ Validate VDI performance, user logon experience, profile management (FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management), and capacity after each stage of the migration.

* VDI Migration Planning & Execution (VMware Exit)

+ Assess the VMware vSphere 8.0 VDI estate (hosts, catalogs, golden images, persistent vs non-persistent desktops, networks, datastores) and produce the migration plan and schedule against the 11 November 2026 deadline.
+ Run a rolling migration: evacuate a host, rebuild it as XenServer, move desktop capacity in phases by delivery group/user population, and repeat, avoiding disruption to users.
+ Rebuild non-persistent catalogs from new XenServer golden images and convert persistent desktops using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or other V2V tooling, including VMware Tools removal and XenServer VM Tools installation.
+ Define pilot, UAT, validation, and rollback procedures for each stage, and coordinate change windows, out-of-hours activity, and user communications with the client.
+ Decommission VMware hosts once desktops are verified and signed off.

* Security, Automation & Handover

+ Apply security hardening to XenServer hosts and golden images aligned to CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Security Baselines, and vendor guidance.
+ Establish patching and lifecycle processes for XenServer hosts, VDAs, and golden images.
+ Automate repetitive build, image, and migration tasks using PowerShell (Citrix PowerShell SDK, XenServer SDK) and the xe CLI.
+ Produce build documentation, runbooks, and operational handover for the client's infrastructure and Citrix teams, and brief them on day-to-day management.
+ Coordinate with the Hyper-V server workstream on shared hardware, networks, storage, and the overall migration schedule.

**Qualification, Skills And Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in virtualisation and end-user computing / VDI infrastructure, with deep hands-on expertise in Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor, including host builds, resource pools, storage repositories, multipathing, NIC bonding, pool HA, XenCenter, and the xe CLI.
* Strong experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, including Delivery Controllers, hosting connections, machine catalogs, delivery groups, and MCS/PVS.
* Proven experience running VDI at scale (400+ desktops), including golden image build, optimisation, and VDA lifecycle management.
* Proven experience migrating VDI workloads between hypervisors with minimal user disruption, using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or image-rebuild approaches.
* Good understanding of VMware vSphere/ESXi 7.x/8.x, including vCenter, VMware Tools removal, and host decommissioning.
* Hands-on experience with HPE ProLiant servers, including iLO, firmware/SPP compliance, and Smart Array configuration.
* Good understanding of storage and SAN technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, and multipathing, and storage performance/IOPS sizing for VDI.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, LACP/NIC bonding, switching, firewalls, and Citrix HDX/ICA traffic.
* Strong experience with Windows 10/11 desktop and Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy management.
* Experience with user profile management (FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management) and VDI performance and logon troubleshooting using Citrix Director or similar tools.
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting (including the Citrix PowerShell SDK) for automation, administration, and migration tasks.
* Experience implementing security baselines and hardening standards for hosts and golden images, and managing patching across hypervisors and desktops.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across XenServer, Citrix, Windows, networking, storage, and other infrastructure layers.
* Experience producing migration runbooks, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and working within change management processes.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical solutions, operational procedures, and handover material.
* Exposure to Microsoft Hyper-V or Citrix DaaS / Citrix Cloud is desirable.
* Prior VMware exit / hypervisor replatforming project experience is desirable.
* Relevant certifications are desirable: Citrix (CCA-V / CCP-V) or VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV).

**Why should you join Dataction?**

title: Sr. System Administrator
description:
Senior Server Administrator – IT Infrastructure
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Senior Server Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s server and IT infrastructure environment. The role will ensure that infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, highly available, and aligned with business requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide senior-level technical expertise across physical and virtual server environments, operating systems, storage, backup, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure security. They will also play a key role in incident resolution, infrastructure projects, service improvements, and technical planning.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Server & Infrastructure Administration
  
  

* Administer and maintain Windows and/or Linux server environments across physical and virtual platforms.
* Manage server hardware, operating systems, virtualisation platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure services.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
* Perform server builds, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning in accordance with established standards.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, configuration records, and technical procedures.
* Ensure infrastructure platforms are appropriately configured for availability, performance, and resilience.

Infrastructure Operations & Support
  
  

* Provide senior-level technical support for infrastructure incidents, service requests, and problems.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, networking, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours support rota where required.
* Lead or support the resolution of major incidents and provide root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Work closely with service desk, network, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Maintain server security in line with organisational policies and industry best practices.
* Manage operating system patching, vulnerability remediation, antivirus/endpoint protection, and security configuration.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements, and infrastructure risk assessments.
* Implement and maintain appropriate access controls, privileged access, and server hardening standards.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to investigate and remediate infrastructure security incidents.

Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity
  
  

* Manage and monitor server backup and recovery solutions.
* Regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support the development and maintenance of infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Ensure critical infrastructure services meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.

Projects & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects, including server upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, virtualisation, and technology refresh programmes.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure services.
* Identify opportunities to automate routine administration and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain technical standards, processes, and best-practice procedures.
* Support capacity planning and future infrastructure strategy.

Stakeholder & Supplier Management
  
  

* Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party suppliers.
* Provide technical guidance and communicate complex infrastructure issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support supplier management, technical reviews, and service improvement activities where required.
* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior infrastructure team members.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in a senior server/infrastructure administration role.
* Strong experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core infrastructure services.
* Experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, networking, and infrastructure architecture.
* Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong knowledge of server security, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and hardening.
* Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and performing root-cause analysis.
* Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management processes.
* Experience working with monitoring and infrastructure management tools.
* Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.

Desirable Skills
  
  

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure platforms.
* Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting/automation technologies.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with enterprise storage technologies.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Linux, ITIL, or cloud certifications.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Technical expertise: Demonstrates strong knowledge of server and infrastructure technologies.
* Problem solving: Able to diagnose complex technical problems and develop effective solutions.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility for infrastructure services and follows issues through to resolution.
* Communication: Communicates clearly with technical teams, management, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, performance, and efficiency.
* Teamwork: Works effectively across IT teams and supports knowledge sharing.
* Resilience: Able to manage priorities and remain effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Infrastructure availability and reliability.
* Timely resolution of infrastructure incidents and problems.
* Successful completion of infrastructure projects and upgrades.
* Server patching and vulnerability remediation compliance.
* Backup success rates and successful recovery testing.
* Infrastructure security and compliance performance.
* Reduction in recurring incidents and infrastructure-related risks.
* Quality and accuracy of infrastructure documentation.
* Delivery of automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Role Summary
  
  
The Senior Server Administrator will be a key member of the IT Infrastructure team, responsible for ensuring the stability, security, resilience, and performance of critical server and infrastructure services. The role requires a proactive and technically capable individual who can manage day-to-day operations while also contributing to strategic infrastructure improvements and business continuity.

title: WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager
description:
**We Offer**
The WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager combines two equally important responsibilities within KION's Enterprise Network service. Approximately 50% of the role governs the global WAN managed service, and approximately 50% coordinates service delivery and BAU operations across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI.
  
  
For WAN governance, the role monitors supplier delivery, contractual performance, service levels, lifecycle, risks, costs and improvement actions. The role prepares analysis, forecasts, recommendations and decision proposals for the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Budget accountability, cost-centre responsibility, contract ownership and final commercial decisions remain with the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Day-to-day operational coordination with the WAN managed service provider is performed by a designated WAN Operations Coordinator under the functional guidance of this role; overall WAN governance responsibility remains with this position.
  
  
For network service delivery, the role coordinates the shared operating model, queues, incidents, service requests, changes, problems, operational readiness and performance reporting. The role has no disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility for network engineers. Engineering capacity and line management remain with the responsible managers, while this role provides process coordination, prioritisation transparency and cross-domain escalation.
  
  
The role works closely with the Enterprise Network Service Owner, Lead Network Architect, network engineers, IT Service Management, regional IT teams, Procurement, Finance and external network providers.
  
  
**Tasks And Qualifications**

* WAN governance, roadmap and lifecycle - 15%
* Prepare and maintain the proposed WAN service roadmap in alignment with the Enterprise Network Service Owner and Lead Network Architect.
* Identify lifecycle, resilience, capacity, sourcing and technical-debt risks and prepare recommendations for accountable decision makers.
* Track approved governance decisions and improvement actions to completion.
* WAN supplier and contractual-performance governance - 15%
* Act as the primary operational governance interface for the WAN managed service provider, carriers and access providers.
* Monitor SLAs, KPIs, contractual obligations, potential service credits, risks and supplier commitments.
* Prepare evidence and recommendations for contract, renewal and commercial decisions owned by the Enterprise Network Service Owner.
* Lead supplier service reviews and escalate recurring underperformance, weak corrective actions and unresolved risks.
* WAN cost transparency, demand and transition assurance - 10%
* Prepare cost, consumption and forecast transparency for review and approval by the Enterprise Network Service Owner; the role has no budget or cost-centre accountability.
* Assess the WAN service, supplier, commercial and operational implications of approved demands.
* Coordinate provider estimates, service acceptance and transition requirements with the demand owner, Lead Network Architect and Enterprise Network Service Owner.
* Ensure operational acceptance covers documentation, monitoring, testing, support routes, supplier acceptance and handover.
* WAN performance, data and continual improvement - 10%
* Maintain WAN scorecards covering availability, incidents, capacity, resilience, change quality, supplier performance and cost transparency.
* Coordinate supplier follow-up after significant interruptions, including RCA quality and preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate governance artefacts and promote consistent data across ITSM, CMDB, monitoring, inventory and source-of-truth capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for automation, observability, data-quality improvement and reduced manual coordination.
* Enterprise Network operations coordination - 20%
* Coordinate the BAU operating model across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI without assuming disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility.
* Run queue reviews, service-health reviews and handover checkpoints; make ageing, blocked work and coverage gaps transparent.
* Coordinate operational priorities with line managers and engineering leads and escalate unresolved capacity conflicts to the Service Owner.
* Provide functional guidance to the designated WAN Operations Coordinator responsible for daily KION-provider coordination.
* Incident and service-request coordination - 15%
* Coordinate triage, ownership, progression and documentation for incidents and service requests in the shared Enterprise Network queue.
* Coordinate cross-domain and high-priority incidents, bringing together network, security, application, infrastructure and supplier teams.
* Ensure clear ownership, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and disciplined technical handovers; specialist teams retain technical resolution responsibility.
* Monitor ticket ageing, reassignments and documentation quality and drive corrective action where required.
* Change, problem and operational-readiness governance - 10%
* Coordinate operational risk reviews for significant or high-risk network changes, including production dependencies and rollback readiness.
* Drive follow-up of recurring problems, RCAs, known errors and preventive actions.
* Confirm that new or changed services enter BAU with monitoring, documentation, runbooks, support ownership, access and escalation routes in place.
* Operational performance and service improvement - 5%
* Report queue health, response and restoration performance, recurring incidents, backlog, monitoring coverage and handover quality.
* Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, escalation contacts, service maps and operational knowledge.
* Use operational trends to recommend improvements to resilience, automation, standards and training

Interfaces
  
  
**Internal**

* Secure Connectivity platform leadership, functional and team leads, and rotating operations engineers
* Enterprise and Network architecture; Cybersecurity and Information Security
* IT Service Management, e.g. Service Desk, (Major) Incident, Problem and Change
* Procurement, Legal, Finance/Controlling and Vendor Management
* Regional and onsite IT, business partners, programme and project managers
* Cloud, datacentre, workplace, decentralised infrastructure and application teams

**External**

* Telecommunications carriers and local access providers
* Managed network and security service providers
* Network technology vendors, integrators and professional-services partners
* Auditors and specialist advisers where required

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**
**Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**
*Platform architecture and evolution*
**Function -**
Infrastructure & Operations
  
  
**Coverage -**
Across all clients
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer is the senior technical owner of Merkle Denmark’s cloud platform architecture. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the cloud foundations, guardrails, and platform capabilities that underpin client operations — ensuring environments are reliable, secure, and well-governed.
  
  
The role is a hands-on specialist position. It sets the direction for how cloud infrastructure is designed, built, and hardened across client accounts, and provides deep technical input on complex incidents, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions. People leadership, resource allocation, and day-to-day team direction sit with the Engineering Director.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering**

* Architect and build cloud foundations and platform capabilities across client environments.
* Define secure-by-design patterns, guardrails, and platform standards for Cloud Operations to operate within.
* Design resilience and continuity architecture, including backup/restore strategy and disaster recovery.
* Own and evolve infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices and tooling standards.
* Drive continuous improvement of the platform approach, ensuring it evolves with client needs and industry practice.
* Provide specialist guidance to Cloud Operations Engineers during complex incident investigations, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions.
* Assess and respond to critical CVEs and security advisory items, coordinating with dentsu EMEA security where required.

**Operational Governance**

* Define platform-level patterns that support incident management, change management, SLA governance, and on-call practice.
* Provide senior technical input on P1/critical incidents and client-impacting situations where infrastructure or platform expertise is needed.
* Ensure platform ownership responsibilities are clearly defined and applied — Cloud Ops owns production stability; Cloud Infrastructure owns design and evolution.
* Maintain platform design standards that support audit-readiness, NIS2, and client contractual obligations.
* Contribute to operational reporting quality, including platform health signals and SLA-relevant metrics.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as senior technical point of contact for client escalations requiring infrastructure or platform expertise.
* Collaborate with Project Managers and delivery teams on change planning, release readiness, and deployment governance.
* Contribute to account-level technical conversations, including architecture reviews and SLA design.
* Support pre-sales and proposal work where infrastructure architecture or managed operations expertise is required.

**Must-Have Skillset –**
**Cloud Infrastructure Engineer -Over 8+ years of exp**

* Cloud Architecture Expertise (Azure, AWS, or GCP)Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud platforms Define platform guardrails and architecture standards
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or equivalent Building and maintaining automated infrastructure deployments
* Cloud Security & Compliance Secure-by-design architecture principles Platform-level security controls, vulnerability/CVE management Understanding of compliance frameworks, governance, and audit requirements
* Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity Design and implementation of DR, backup, restore, and resilience strategiesHigh availability and fault-tolerant architecture design
* ITIL / ITSM Knowledge Strong understanding of: Incident Management hange Management Problem Management SLA Governance
* Critical Incident & Escalation Management Experience providing technical leadership during P1/P0 incidents Root cause analysis and architecture-level problem resolution
* Operational Governance Define platform standards, operational patterns, and best practices Support incident, change, and service management frameworks
* Client & Stakeholder Management Act as senior technical advisor during architecture reviews Experience working directly with enterprise clients and stakeholders
* Multi-Cloud & Managed Services Experience Experience in professional services, managed operations, or multi-client environments Understanding of contractual obligations, SLAs, and service delivery models
* Technical Skills Networking (VNet/VPC, VPN, Load Balancers, DNS, Firewalls)Windows/Linux Server Administration Containers & Kubernetes Monitoring & Observability tools Automation and Scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)
* Experience with NIS2, GDPR, and data processing regulations
* Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or CI/CD expertise
* Excellent written and verbal English communication Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders

**Nice-to-Have**

* Danish language proficiency
* Public sector or enterprise platform experience

Working Context
  
  
The role sits within the Merkle Denmark engineering organisation, reporting to the CTO and working closely with the Engineering Director, Infrastructure & Operations. The Infrastructure & Operations function is distributed across Denmark, Bulgaria, India, and the Philippines, and operates across multiple client accounts including public sector and enterprise digital platforms.
  
  
The function works within a ticket-first, evidence-driven operational model. Production is owned by Cloud Operations; platform architecture and guardrails are owned by Cloud Infrastructure Engineering. This separation of duties supports governance, auditability, and clear accountability.

DGS India - Pune - Indiqube Orchid

Merkle

Full time

Permanent#DGS

* Customer-obsessed mindset, maintaining deep empathy for internal and external stakeholders to anchor every architectural recommendation in real-world customer success.

* Proven expertise in translating complex technical architectures into defined project phases, tangible deliverables, and precise level-of-effort (LOE) Statement of Work (SOW) scopes

**Working Pattern and Coverage**

title: Customer Delivery Architect | 10+ years, SOC transformation
description:
**Meet the Team**
Cisco Customer Experience (CX) Security Services is a global team of elite security practitioners, architects, and trusted advisors who help our largest enterprise and service provider customers defend against sophisticated threats, achieve operational cyber resilience, and accelerate digital transformation. As part of our specialized Security Operations Center (SOC) Transformation & Advanced Analytics practice, you will work alongside top-tier consulting engineers, automation developers, and solution architects to design and deliver next-generation SOC architectures, SIEM modernization, behavioral analytics, and end-to-end security automation.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Security Consulting Architect for SOC Transformation & Splunk, you will be the chief technical authority and visionary guiding our enterprise customers through complex SOC modernization journeys. You will translate customer business outcomes, risk profiles, and operational strategies into scalable, high-fidelity security architectures powered by Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), Splunk SOAR, User & Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA), Cribl Stream, and modern object storage (MinIO).
  
  
This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will engage with customer CISOs, SOC Directors, and Enterprise Architects to define target operating models and modernization roadmaps, while also leading implementation pods, troubleshooting deep technical roadblocks, optimizing search pipelines, and setting the engineering standards for multi-terabyte security analytics.
  
  

* Target SOC Architecture & Transformation Strategy: Lead the architectural design, Target Operating Model (TOM), and delivery strategy for multi-tier enterprise SOCs, SIEM modernizations, and security automation frameworks aligned with MITRE ATT&CK and Cisco Validated Designs.
* Splunk Cloud & Enterprise Security (ES) Mastery: Architect enterprise-scale Splunk Cloud deployments; design Risk-Based Alerting (RBA) frameworks, Data Model Acceleration (DMA) strategies, optimized | tstats search pipelines, Asset & Identity (A&I) contextual enrichment, and ESCU detection updates to eliminate alert fatigue.
* Modern Telemetry Ingestion & Storage Architecture: Architect high-throughput, resilient security data collection pipelines leveraging Cribl Stream for edge transformation, filtering, and routing, combined with MinIO / S3-compatible object storage for high-performance SmartStore tiering and compliance data archiving.
* Security Automation & SOAR Engineering: Define incident triage and response workflows, designing modular, production-grade Python playbooks in Splunk SOAR for automated threat enrichment (Talos, VirusTotal), endpoint containment (EDR isolation), firewall mitigation, and bidirectional ITSM (ServiceNow) synchronization.
* Technical Pod Leadership & Governance: Provide technical direction, architectural governance, and mentorship to specialized engineering execution pods (Data Ingestion/GDI, Detection Engineering, UEBA, SOAR); serve as the hands-on escalation authority for complex SPL optimization, CIM normalization, and API integrations.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical cybersecurity engineering and architecture experience designing and deploying enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC) environments and SIEM/SOAR platforms.
* 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on architecture and engineering experience with Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Cloud, and Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), including correlation search engineering, Data Model Acceleration, and Risk-Based Alerting (RBA).
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in security telemetry pipeline engineering, including log routing and normalization with Cribl Stream, data parsing (props.conf / transforms.conf), and object storage/SmartStore tiering with MinIO or S3-compatible cloud storage.
* 3+ years of security orchestration and automation experience designing and building automated response playbooks using Splunk SOAR (Phantom), REST APIs, and Python
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical industry engineering experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Splunk & Pipeline Certifications: Splunk Enterprise Certified Architect, Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin, Splunk SOAR Certified Automation Developer, or Cribl Certified Observability Engineer (CCOE).
* Industry Security Credentials: CISSP, CCIE Security, CISM, or GIAC certifications (GCIH, GCIA, GDSA, GMON).
* Advanced Behavioral Analytics & Threat Modeling: Practical experience deploying Splunk UEBA, implementing machine learning models for anomaly detection, and conducting atomic detection testing against the MITRE ATT&CK matrix.
* Executive Advisory & Technical Consulting: Exceptional C-suite consulting, presentation, and technical leadership skills with a proven track record of advising CISOs, leading technical workshops, and driving organizational change.
* Hybrid Cloud & Multi-Vendor Ecosystem Integration: Deep knowledge of multi-cloud security logging, Next-Gen Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco Secure Firewall), EDR platforms (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender), and Cisco Security Cloud integrations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. title: Senior Engineer - Network
description:
**Job Title: Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer**
**Location- Pune/Bangalore**
**What You Will Do**
As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security & perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. This is a senior, hands-on role with a strong emphasis on our Zscaler platform – including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zscaler AI Security – underpinning JCI’s Zero Trust program.
  
  
Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.
  
  
The role will be working as part of a global high-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Manage and implement network security infrastructure
* Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation
* Build and tune ZIA/ZPA access policies, SSL inspection, DLP dictionaries and AI Security controls, and lead the migration of users to full SSE capability
* Firewall, IPS/IDS and remote access configuration and rule management across the Fortinet estate (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer)
* Cloud-based Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF), microsegmentation and workload protection (Zscaler and Akamai Guardicore), and perimeter/geo-blocking controls
* Design, build, operate and automate security solutions and processes to protect the integrity of the organization's networks, systems, applications and data.
* Work closely with Security team partners/Business Relationship Managers , Field IT leadership and managed service suppliers to ensure successful identification and timely delivery of network security services to the business.
* Participate and consult(in partnership with the Network lifecycle refresh team) the identification, selection and prioritization of security infrastructure refresh components to ensure alignment with risk avoidance, strategic goals and organizational priorities.
* Respond to security incidents, including data breaches, and coordinate with other IT teams to mitigate the impact of any security breaches.
* Conduct regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities in the network and implement measures to address them.
* Partner with IT audit to remediate security gaps in a timley manner.
* Drive and develop automation opportunities for the management of security infrastructure.
* Manage the global Network security infrastrucutre inventory in CMDB.
* Ensure timely quote turnaround for security infrastructure delivery.
* Ensure all network asset data is accurate and support contracts are in place.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and operations staff, set standards and act as an escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
* Lead delivery of the Zero Trust program, including microsegmentation of crown-jewel applications with Zscaler and Guardicore, geo-blocking and reduction of the internet-facing attack surface.

**Required**
**What we look for:**

* Deep, hands-on expertise with the Zscaler platform is essential – Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler DLP and Zscaler AI Security (Secure AI Access), including policy design, SSL inspection, App Connectors/Service Edges and tenant administration.
* Strong network infrastructure security background across both on-prem physical components (firewalls, IDS/IPS, remote access) and cloud security services (Zscaler, Azure, AWS), plus experience with Zscaler ZDX and microsegmentation (Zscaler and/or Guardicore).
* Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security-related changes in a production environment.
* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
* Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
* Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.
* Solid technical understanding of DMZs, security policies, secure application traffic flows, WAF, DDoS protection, SSL offloading and inspection.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Network Architecture
* Experience with private and public cloud providers is a plus, (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Nutanix) particularly in connectivity, availability, resilience, and security.
* Familiarity with service now Ticketing and CMDB is desirable
* Demonstrated capability to take part as lead security engineer in multi-phase / multi-year network projects or programs, leading these projects to successful implementation.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skill.
* Strong vendor management experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills to provide clear messages to all levels.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain strategic working relationships with peers and constituents at all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated analysis and problem solving skills using innovative thinking.
* Knowledge of ITIL based practices.
* Knowledge of Python and automation skills are desirable.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other applicable discipline.
* 8+ years of proven, hands-on network security experience at global enterprise organizations, including significant experience owning and operating a Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) environment at scale.

The consultant will work closely with management, internal teams, and external vendors to ensure reliable IT operations, optimize digital platforms, strengthen online visibility, and implement technology-driven solutions that support business growth and customer engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. IT Infrastructure & Systems Management**

* Maintain and troubleshoot computer systems, networks, software, hardware, and other IT infrastructure.
* Evaluate business requirements and recommend suitable technology solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Manage software installations, system updates, user access, backups, and data security.
* Provide technical support to employees and ensure reliable day-to-day IT operations.

**2. Website & Digital Platform Management**

* Manage and maintain the company website, ensuring functionality, performance, mobile responsiveness, and user experience.
* Coordinate website updates, content changes, technical enhancements, and integrations with external developers or service providers.
* Monitor website performance and identify opportunities to improve navigation, lead generation, enquiry forms, and customer engagement.
* Manage relevant digital tools, CRM platforms, hosting services, and website analytics.

**3. Digital Media & Online Presence**

* Manage and maintain company digital media platforms and online business profiles, ensuring consistent branding and accurate information.
* Coordinate digital content publishing, scheduling tools, and platform administration in collaboration with the marketing team.
* Support digital marketing initiatives through campaign tracking tools, analytics, and performance monitoring.
* Maintain account security, access permissions, and administrative control across company-managed digital platforms.

**4. Digital Transformation & Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and streamline business workflows using technology.
* Recommend and implement cloud-based applications, CRM systems, productivity tools, and workflow automation solutions.
* Explore integrations between the website, customer enquiry systems, and internal business applications.
* Support technology initiatives that improve travel planning, customer service, lead management, and operational efficiency.

**5. Data Security, Analytics & Reporting**

* Implement appropriate cybersecurity, data protection, backup, and recovery practices.
* Monitor IT systems, website analytics, and digital platform performance to identify improvement opportunities.
* Prepare reports on system performance, website activity, and digital engagement metrics.
* Maintain IT documentation, standard operating procedures, and technology usage guidelines.

**6. Vendor Coordination & Employee Support**

* Coordinate with website developers, hosting providers, software vendors, and external digital service providers.
* Evaluate technology solutions based on business requirements, security, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
* Train employees on IT systems, digital tools, and business applications.
* Document technical processes and ensure timely resolution of IT and digital platform issues.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Applications, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, systems administration, networking, software, and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience in website management, CMS platforms, hosting, and website maintenance.
* Familiarity with social media platforms, online business profiles, digital tools, and website analytics.
* Knowledge of CRM systems, cloud applications, SEO fundamentals, digital marketing tools, and workflow automation is desirable.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, data protection, backups, and digital account management.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and project coordination skills.
* Ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams and manage external vendors effectively.
* Prior experience in IT consulting, digital technology, or the travel and hospitality industry is an advantage.

**Role Expectations**

The candidate will be responsible for the company’s overall IT and digital technology ecosystem, ensuring efficient internal systems, secure operations, and well-maintained digital platforms. The role extends beyond conventional IT support to include website management, digital media administration, performance monitoring, and technology-driven business improvement. The ideal candidate will take ownership of these responsibilities and identify opportunities to strengthen the company’s digital presence and operational capabilities.
